sentences.en: And when I weigh everything, my own thoughts end up counting for more than the actual evidence.

sentences.en: There are plenty of reasons why we don't see stronger accuracy effects.

sentences.en: And I can briefly go over a few of those.

sentences.en: So one is that many behaviors are ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 首先，许多行为是模棱两可的。

sentences.en: We don't know what's driving our partner to behave in a particular way.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是什么驱使我们的伴侣做出某种特定行为。

sentences.en: And that creates room for subjective interpretations.
sentences.zh: 这就为主观解释留下了空间。

sentences.en: So, for example, when our partner gives us unwanted advice when we're venting about a problem we're having at work,
sentences.zh: 比如，当我们向伴侣倾诉在工作中遇到的问题时，伴侣却给我们提供不需要的建议，

sentences.en: we just want to get our feelings out and maybe receive a bit of emotional support.

sentences.en: And our partner tells us how we should handle it, which can be a bit off-putting.

sentences.en: And you could interpret that in a couple different ways.

sentences.en: And then our behavior then ends up exacerbating the signals that we may have seen in the first place.
sentences.zh: 接着，我们的行为最终会加剧我们一开始可能看到的那些信号。

sentences.en: Our behavior can exacerbate those signals by changing how the other person actually responds to us.
sentences.zh: 我们的行为可以通过改变对方对我们的实际反应来加剧这些信号。

sentences.en: But in addition, our behavior can alter our own expectations regarding what this interaction is going to be like.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的行为还会改变我们自己对这次互动会是怎样的期望。

sentences.en: It can sort of bring out another side of somebody and cause us to think that the relationship is going to be different now that I behaved in this particular way.
sentences.zh: 它能在某种程度上激发出某人的另一面，并让我们觉得，既然我做出了这种特定的行为，这段关系现在会有所不同。

sentences.en: So bringing this insight back to our romantic relationships, how does our behavior toward our partners shape the way we end up seeing them?
sentences.zh: 那么，将这一见解带回到我们的浪漫关系中，我们对伴侣的行为是如何塑造我们最终看待他们的方式的呢？

sentences.en: So in ongoing relationships, we don't just look at our partner to figure out how our partner feels about us.
sentences.zh: 所以在持续的关系中，我们不仅通过观察伴侣来弄清楚伴侣对我们的感觉。

sentences.en: But we also look at ourselves, our own behavior, such as whether we're warm and supportive toward our partner or conversely, whether we're cold and distant toward our partner,
sentences.zh: 我们还会审视自己，审视我们自己的行为，比如我们对伴侣是否热情和支持，或者相反，我们对伴侣是否冷淡和疏离，

sentences.en: can shape how we think our partners see us, whether they see us as a warm partner or a cold partner.
sentences.zh: 这些都能塑造我们认为伴侣是如何看待我们的，是把我们看作一个热情的伴侣还是一个冷淡的伴侣。

sentences.en: And most of us have expectations that warmth elicits positive feelings in other people, positive attitudes in other people,
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都期望热情会激起别人积极的感情、积极的态度，

sentences.en: and that coldness elicits negative feelings and attitudes in other people.
sentences.zh: 而冷淡会激起别人消极的感情和态度。

sentences.en: So just by being warm, we sort of provide ourselves with a reason to be confident that other people value us and like us and want to be with us.
sentences.zh: 所以，仅仅通过保持热情，我们就为自己提供了一个理由，去确信别人是珍视我们、喜欢我们并希望和我们在一起的。

sentences.en: So when we are warm, it helps us feel more secure that we're loved.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们热情时，它有助于让我们更有安全感，确信自己被爱。

sentences.en: And when we're cold, it can give us a reason to instead have doubts about how much others like us or want to be around us.
sentences.zh: 而当我们冷淡时，它可能会让我们有理由开始怀疑别人有多喜欢我们或想不想和我们待在一起。

sentences.en: In the studies I've done on this topic, we find that in daily life,
sentences.zh: 在我围绕这个主题所做的研究中，我们发现，在日常生活中，

sentences.en: people feel more confident that they're valued by their partners on days when they're especially warm toward their partners.
sentences.zh: 在那些对伴侣格外热情的日子里，人们会更确信自己是被伴侣珍视的。

sentences.en: And they feel less confident, more insecure about how much their partners value them on days when they're cold.
sentences.zh: 而在冷淡的日子里，他们会感到不那么自信，对伴侣有多珍视自己感到更加不安。

sentences.en: We've also done experiments where we've manipulated a person's behavior toward their partner.
sentences.zh: 我们还做过实验，在实验中人为操纵一个人对伴侣的行为。

sentences.en: So we're encouraging them to behave in a supportive or unsupportive way.
sentences.zh: 我们鼓励他们表现出支持或不支持的行为。

sentences.en: And we find that this experimental manipulation alters the person's expectations and feelings of being valued by their partner.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，这种实验操纵改变了该个人的期望以及被伴侣珍视的感觉。

sentences.en: So behavior is an important piece of the puzzle when it comes to understanding how a person comes to feel loved or unloved.
sentences.zh: 因此，在理解一个人如何开始感到被爱或未被爱时，行为是拼图中重要的一块。

sentences.en: Ed, I understand that people in relationships commonly see their partners through the lens of how much they want the relationship to work.
sentences.zh: 埃德，我听说处于恋爱关系中的人通常会通过他们希望关系能够顺利进行的愿望来滤镜式地看待伴侣。

sentences.en: Can you explain this dynamic, how it works?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下这种动态是如何运作的吗？

sentences.en: This is an example of what we like to think of as wishful thinking or to be a little bit more technical, motivated cognition.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的例子，说明了我们喜欢称之为的一厢情愿，或者用更专业一点的话来说，动机性认知。

sentences.en: This idea that the way we think is biased by what we want and that we see the world in a way that sort of subjectively confirms what we most want the world to be like.
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为，我们的思考方式会受到我们渴望的东西的偏见影响，我们以一种主观上证实我们最希望世界成为什么样子的方式来看待世界。

sentences.en: And that also is the case within relationships.
sentences.zh: 在亲密关系中也是如此。

sentences.en: As one concrete example of this, when we strongly want the relationship, if the partner behaves in a way that suggests lack of care, what we do,
sentences.zh: 作为这方面的一个具体例子，当我们极度渴望这段关系时，如果伴侣的表现暗示了缺乏关心，我们会怎么做呢，

sentences.en: we sort of invent excuses that allow us to still feel cared for despite the uncaring behavior that's right in front of us.
sentences.zh: 我们会编造各种借口，让我们在面对眼前缺乏关心的行为时，依然能感到自己是被关爱的。

sentences.en: So one kind of excuse that I've found in my work is that people will convince themselves that they didn't clearly enough communicate their needs to their partner.
sentences.zh: 我在工作中发现的一种借口是，人们会说服自己，他们没有把自己的需求足够清晰地传达给伴侣。

sentences.en: And that explains why their partner is behaving in this unsupportive way.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了为什么他们的伴侣会有这种不支持的行为。

sentences.en: It's not that the partner doesn't care for me, but rather it's the partner just didn't know what I wanted or needed in this particular situation.
sentences.zh: 并不是伴侣不关心我，而是伴侣根本不知道在这个特定情况下我想要什么或需要什么。

sentences.en: So a dramatic example of this kind of motivated cognition comes from the television show Breaking Bad.
sentences.zh: 这种动机性认知的一个戏剧性例子来自电视剧《绝命毒师》。

sentences.en: In the show, Walter White, who is played by Bryan Cranston,
sentences.zh: 在剧中，由布莱恩·克兰斯顿饰演的沃尔特·怀特，

sentences.en: is a high school chemistry teacher who has turned to making and selling drugs in an effort to pay for his cancer treatment.
sentences.zh: 是一名高中化学老师，为了支付癌症治疗费用，他转而开始制造和贩卖毒品。

sentences.en: In this scene, his wife, Skyler, played by Anna Gunn, tries to convince him, once she has found out what's going on, that they should go to the police.
sentences.zh: 在这场戏中，他的妻子斯凯勒（由安娜·冈恩饰演）在发现真相后，试图说服他去报警。

sentences.en: You're not some hardened criminal, Walt.
sentences.zh: 你不是什么劣迹斑斑的罪犯，沃尔特。

sentences.en: You are in over your head.
School teacher, cancer, desperate for money, roped into working, unable to even quit.
sentences.zh: 学校老师，患有癌症，极度缺钱，被诱骗去干活，甚至无法退出。

sentences.en: You told me that yourself, Walt.
sentences.zh: 你自己都这么跟我说过，沃尔特。

sentences.en: Ed, what's your sense of what Skyler is thinking and saying in this scene?
sentences.zh: 埃德，你觉得斯凯勒在这场戏里心里在想什么，嘴上在说什么？

sentences.en: I think that what's striking in this scene is that Skyler is trying to tell a story about who Walter is that allows her to make sense of the situation and to stay in the relationship.
sentences.zh: 我认为这场戏里令人印象深刻的是，斯凯勒试图讲述一个关于沃尔特是谁的故事，这让她能够理解这种状况并留在关系中。

sentences.en: She frames him as someone who's in over his head, who's basically a good person who got pulled into something bad.
sentences.zh: 她把他塑造成一个陷得太深的人，一个本质上卷入了坏事的善良之人。

sentences.en: And that's a very sympathetic version of him.
sentences.zh: 这是一个对他非常同情的版本。

sentences.en: But at that point in the story, that's really not who Walt is anymore.
sentences.zh: 但在故事的那个阶段，沃尔特已经不再是那样的人了。

sentences.en: And I think what you're seeing here is Skyler's motivated perception.
sentences.zh: 我认为你在这里看到的是斯凯勒带有动机的感知。

sentences.en: She's interpreting him in a way that protects something that she deeply cares about, which is her marriage and her family.
sentences.zh: 她对他的解读是为了保护她内心深处极为在乎的东西，也就是她的婚姻和家庭。

sentences.en: So she's, in a sense, holding on to an earlier version of him or a more hopeful version of him,
sentences.zh: 所以在某种意义上，她抓着他早期的一个版本或者更充满希望的版本不放，

sentences.en: because that's the version that makes it possible for her to stay connected with him.
sentences.zh: 因为只有那个版本才能让她有可能继续与他保持联系。

sentences.en: I want to play you a clip from the 1997 movie Good Will Hunting.
sentences.zh: 我想给你放一段1997年电影《心灵捕手》的剪辑。

sentences.en: In this scene, Skyler, played by Minnie Driver, is in a new relationship with Will, who's played by Matt Damon.
sentences.zh: 在这场戏里，由米妮·德赖弗饰演的斯凯勒正与由马特·达蒙饰演的威尔处于一段新的恋爱关系中。

sentences.en: And Skyler is moving to California and has just asked Will to come with her.
sentences.zh: 而斯凯勒正准备搬去加利福尼亚，并刚刚邀请威尔跟她一起去。

sentences.en: Will asks how she knows that she really wants his company.
sentences.zh: 威尔问她怎么知道自己是真的想要他的陪伴。

sentences.en: I know, because I feel it.
sentences.zh: 我知道，因为我能感觉得到。

sentences.en: Because that's a really serious thing you're saying.
sentences.zh: 因为你说的是一件非常严肃的事。

sentences.en: You could be in California next week and, you know, you might find out something about me you don't like and, you know, maybe you wish you hadn't said that.
sentences.zh: 你下周可能就会去加利福尼亚，然后，你知道的，你可能会发现我身上有什么你不喜欢的地方，然后，你知道的，也许你会后悔说过那样的话。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's such a serious thing that you can't take it back.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，这是一件如此严肃的事，以至于你无法收回。

sentences.en: And now I'm stuck in California.
sentences.zh: 而现在我被困在了加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: Someone doesn't really want to be with me, just wish they had a take back.
sentences.zh: 有人其实并不想和我在一起，只是希望他们能收回说过的话。

sentences.en: I don't want to take back.
I just want you to come to California with me.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让你和我一起去加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: So, Ed, what do you hear Will expressing there?
sentences.zh: 那么，埃德，你从威尔那里听出了什么？

sentences.en: How does it relate to your research on the influence of one partner's insecurity within a relationship?
sentences.zh: 这和你关于伴侣在关系中不安全感影响的研究有什么关系？

sentences.en: What I hear in that clip is someone who's deeply unsure about his value as a relationship partner.
sentences.zh: 我在那段音频里听到的是一个对自己作为伴侣的价值深感不确定的人。

sentences.en: And, in particular, unsure about whether Schuyler sees anything worthwhile in having him as a relationship partner.
sentences.zh: 特别是，不确定斯凯勒是否觉得有他这个伴侣有什么价值。

sentences.en: And because of that, he's not just reacting to what Schuyler is doing.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他不仅仅是在对斯凯勒的做法做出反应。

sentences.en: He's interpreting the relationship through the lens of his insecurities.
sentences.zh: 他是在透过自己不安全感的有色眼镜来解读这段关系。

sentences.en: And he's not just saying, you know, look, I'm really insecure and I'm worried that this is going to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是在说，你看，我真的很没有安全感，我担心这段感情会破裂。

sentences.en: He's basically saying, what happens when we get to California and you decide you don't want to be with me?
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，等我们到了加利福尼亚，你决定不想和我在一起了，那该怎么办？

sentences.en: So, in other words, he's seeing in her behavior, her future behavior, his present insecurities.
sentences.zh: 所以换句话说，他从她的行为——她未来的行为中，看到了自己目前的不安全感。

sentences.en: He is using his insecurities regarding how much she values him to forecast where this relationship will go.
sentences.zh: 他正在用自己关于她有多珍视自己的不安全感，来预测这段关系的发展方向。

sentences.en: And he has a very pessimistic outlook on the future of their relationship.
sentences.zh: 而且他对他们关系的未来有着非常悲观的看法。
从本质上讲，他预料到了拒绝。

sentences.en: It's amazing how many of these projections end up being effectively self-fulfilling prophecies.
sentences.zh: 令人惊奇的是，其中许多投射最终都变成了实际上会自我实现的预言。

sentences.en: That's correct, yeah, because having these perceptions of being devalued by the partner
sentences.zh: 没错，是的，因为产生这种被伴侣贬低的想法

sentences.en: and questioning the authenticity of the partner's expressions of love
sentences.zh: 并质疑伴侣表达爱意的真实性

sentences.en: can lead the insecure person into behaving in negative ways that can actually push the partner away.
sentences.zh: 可能会导致缺乏安全感的人做出负面行为，从而真的把伴侣推开。

sentences.en: When we ask ourselves what our partners are thinking and feeling,
sentences.zh: 当我们问自己伴侣在想什么、感受什么时，

sentences.en: it can feel like we're simply reading reality.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会觉得这就像是在直接解读现实。

sentences.en: But as Ed's research shows, we're often reading our own fears, hopes, and expectations.
sentences.zh: 但正如埃德的研究所示，我们往往是在解读我们自己的恐惧、希望和期望。

sentences.en: These projections can quietly shape the course of a relationship for better and for worse.
sentences.zh: 这些投射会悄然塑造一段关系的走向，不论是好是坏。

sentences.en: When we come back, how to work skillfully with the projections we cast onto those we love.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将探讨如何巧妙地处理我们投射到所爱之人身上的心理。
您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: As you've listened to the story, have you thought of ways in which your own projections
sentences.zh: 当你听这个故事时，你有没有想过，你自己的投射方式

sentences.en: shape your behavior and feelings toward your partner?
sentences.zh: 是如何塑造你对伴侣的行为和感受的？

sentences.en: Can you think of times when other people's projections have shaped the way they behave toward you?
sentences.zh: 你能想起什么时候别人的投射塑造了他们对待你的方式吗？

sentences.en: If you have a personal story you would be willing to share with the Hidden Brain audience
sentences.zh: 如果你有一个愿意与《隐藏的大脑》听众分享的个人故事，

sentences.en: or a question or comment about this episode,
sentences.zh: 或者对本集节目有任何疑问或评论，

sentences.en: please find a very quiet room and record a voice memo on your phone.
sentences.zh: 请找一个非常安静的房间，在手机上录下一条语音备忘录。

sentences.en: Two or three minutes is plenty.
Email the file to us at feedback at hiddenbrain.org
sentences.zh: 将文件发送电子邮件至 feedback@hiddenbrain.org

sentences.en: Psychologist Ed LeMay's research suggests that we persistently view our partners
sentences.zh: 心理学家埃德·勒迈的研究表明，我们总是带着

sentences.en: through lenses colored by our own fears, desires, and insecurities.
sentences.zh: 被自身的恐惧、欲望和不安全感染色的有色眼镜来看待伴侣。

sentences.en: These filters cause us to misread our partners in ways that can create confusion, conflict, and distance.
sentences.zh: 这些过滤镜导致我们误解伴侣，从而造成困惑、冲突和疏离。

sentences.en: Ed suggests that by becoming aware of these projections
sentences.zh: 埃德指出，通过意识到这些投射

sentences.en: and working with them in intentional, skillful ways,
sentences.zh: 并以有意、巧妙的方式处理它们，

sentences.en: we can improve our relationships with the people we love.
sentences.zh: 我们可以改善与所爱之人的关系。

sentences.en: Ed, I'm wondering whether we want to see our partners as clearly as possible
sentences.zh: 埃德，我想知道我们是想尽可能清楚地看到我们的伴侣，

sentences.en: or we want to see them as skillfully as possible.
sentences.zh: 还是想尽可能巧妙地看到他们。

sentences.en: Well, I think that the key is that we don't want to see our partners unrealistically.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为关键在于我们不要不切实际地看待伴侣。

sentences.en: We want to see them generously while still staying grounded in reality.
sentences.zh: 我们要以宽容的眼光看待他们，同时依然脚踏实地面对现实。

sentences.en: And I think that one way people do this is by giving their partner the benefit of the doubt
sentences.zh: 我认为人们做到这一点的方法之一是，在事情模棱两可时，

sentences.en: when things are ambiguous, assuming good intentions rather than the worSt.
sentences.zh: 给予伴侣充分的信任，往好的方面想，而不是往最坏处想。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it's important to stay open to new information.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，保持对新信息的开放态度也很重要。

sentences.en: So if there is a consistent pattern of troubling behavior, you don't want to explain that away.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果存在持续令人不安的行为模式，你不能找借口将其合理化。

sentences.en: In fact, that's why people, some people end up staying in relationships that are really not good for them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这就是为什么有些人最终会留在对他们非常不利的关系中。

sentences.en: So it's really about a balance, holding on to a generally positive view of the partner
sentences.zh: 所以这其实关乎一种平衡，一方面对伴侣保持普遍积极的看法，

sentences.en: while still updating that view when the evidence calls for updating.
sentences.zh: 另一方面当证据需要更新时及时更新这种看法。

sentences.en: And when people get that balance right, it tends to promote trust, stability, and satisfaction in their relationship.
sentences.zh: 当人们把握好这种平衡时，它往往会促进关系中的信任、稳定和满意度。

sentences.en: And as we've discussed before, can even have positive effects on how the partner feels about us and how they treat us.
sentences.zh: 正如我们之前讨论过的，甚至会对伴侣对我们的感觉以及他们如何对待我们产生积极影响。

sentences.en: So let's unpack this a little bit.
sentences.zh: 让我们稍微深入剖析一下这一点。

sentences.en: But let's start with the idea of positive illusions.
sentences.zh: 但让我们从积极错觉的概念开始。

sentences.en: This idea has been around for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 这个概念已经存在很久了。

sentences.en: Talk for a moment about how positive illusions about our partner can be a good thing for our relationships.
sentences.zh: 请谈谈为什么对伴侣的积极错觉对我们的关系有好处。

sentences.en: Positive illusions can be a good thing for our relationships because it helps us have the sense
sentences.zh: 积极错觉对我们的关系有好处，因为它有助于让我们产生一种感觉，

sentences.en: that the person that we've committed to is the right person for us.
sentences.zh: 即我们所承诺的那个人正是适合我们的人。

sentences.en: It can help alleviate doubts that many of us would otherwise have regarding whether we've made the right choice or not.
sentences.zh: 它可以帮助减轻我们许多人在其他情况下会产生的怀疑，即我们是否做出了正确的选择。

sentences.en: And so that can promote a sense of satisfaction with the relationship.
sentences.zh: 因此，这可以提升对关系的满意度。

sentences.en: And then that sense of satisfaction can in turn affect how we behave toward the partner,
sentences.zh: 然后这种满意度反过来又会影响我们对待伴侣的方式，

sentences.en: can make us feel committed to that partner and engage in a variety of behaviors that help create the positive relationship that we want.
sentences.zh: 会让我们对伴侣感到忠诚，并做出各种有助于创造我们想要的积极关系的行为。

sentences.en: In addition, like the self-fulfilling prophecy we talked about before, it can have an effect on the partner.
sentences.zh: 此外，就像我们之前谈到的自我实现预言一样，它会对伴侣产生影响。

sentences.en: So the partners may have more positive experiences with us when we entertain these positive illusions.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们怀有这些积极错觉时，伴侣可能会与我们有更多积极的体验。

sentences.en: And the partner's feeling of satisfaction in turn can result in them behaving in the positive way that we perceived initially.
sentences.zh: 而伴侣的满意感反过来又会促使他们表现出我们最初所感受到的积极方式。
